author: agent:claude-code
message: The checks CI and the contributing guide already run, attached to the nodes they cover, so Tend can run them and score each node against them.

check.name: workspace tests
check.notes: Every crate's unit and integration tests (CI's test job, Linux and Windows).

check.name: clippy
check.notes: Warnings denied, every feature on; also run with --no-default-features before a commit.

check.name: cargo deny
check.notes: Licenses, RustSec advisories and dependency sources (deny.toml).

check.name: scipy parity
check.notes: Against SciPy / NumPy / statsmodels / python-control fixtures generated by tests/scipy/gen_fixtures.py.

check.name: schur and reordering
check.notes: Residual, orthogonality and exact quasi-triangular structure on hard matrices either side of every threshold; block swaps.

check.name: no allocation
check.notes: The real-time rule: processing never allocates.

check.name: gpu
check.notes: Skips itself without a GPU adapter.

check.name: flux backends
check.notes: IREE (AUTODYNE_IREE_DIR, AUTODYNE_IREE_GPU=vulkan=ampere,cuda=sm_80), PJRT (AUTODYNE_PJRT_PLUGIN) and XLA through JAX (AUTODYNE_XLA_PYTHON); each missing backend is reported and skipped.

check.name: pytest
check.run: cd bindings/python && cargo clippy -- -D warnings && maturin develop --release && python -m pytest tests -q
check.notes: In the bindings' own venv (bindings/python/.venv); AUTODYNE_IREE_DIR enables the flux backend test.

check.name: numpy and scipy
check.notes: With the bindings installed; single-threaded on both sides; re-time surprising rows in isolation.

check.name: rust libraries
check.run: cd bench/rust && cargo bench --bench compare && python results.py --out RESULTS.md

check.name: flux vs jax
check.run: cargo run --release --features flux --example flux_programs -- <dir> && python bench/flux/compare_jax.py <dir> --out bench/flux/RESULTS.md
check.unit: x (JAX run time / flux run time)
